package domain

// CourseLessonSourceBinding is an immutable reference from Knowledge Tree to
// one lesson placed in one course.
type CourseLessonSourceBinding struct {
	CourseSourceKey string
	LessonSourceKey string
}

// ResolvedCourseLessonBinding carries the live course-service identifiers for
// an exact source-key pair. IDs are not derived by a consumer.
type ResolvedCourseLessonBinding struct {
	CourseLessonSourceBinding
	CourseID string
	LessonID string
}
